description: Create a zone of defense on the ground for you and your allies.
Creates an Aura of Fire around you.
Creates an Aura of Poison around you.
Send a homing projectile that applies Bleed.
Fires projectiles in all directions dealing Magic damage and knocking away enemies.
Summon a stalagmite wave from the earth to deal Crushing damage to enemies in its path.
A circle of egregore hellgrowth erupts from the ground dealing damage to all enemies within.
Increases your Defenses and Damage of all types.
Throw a burst of flames at your enemies while applying a stack of Burning.
Leaves a trail of Fire behind while moving.
Invoke a fireball that fires forward from your shield.
Hurl your weapon and apply Bleed, then attack again to recall it on command.
Cast homing orbs towards your foes. Deals Fire Damage.
Leaves a trail of Frost while moving.
Hurl your weapon at an enemy, then attack again to recall it on command.
Burst into flames dealing Burning and damage to all enemies within 4 meters and yourself.
Summon pillars of blinding light to deal Magic damage around target enemy.
Dodge and drop a zone of Poison at your previous location.
Leaves a trail of Poison while moving.
Consume all status effects on Targeted enemy to cause a burst of damage.
Spin with your weapon, spawning Frost projectiles and striking nearby foes with Frost Attack.
Slash across your enemy dealing damage and Bleed.
Blast forward with your shield and deal Crushing damage.
Raise thorns in a wave in front of you, dealing damage and Poison to enemies in its path.
Slam down your weapon releasing a spray of magic flames.
Spin with your weapon, striking all nearby foes with increased Attack.
Summon a wedge of ice from the ground and deal Frost.
Encase nearby foes with Frost.
